# JSON for Modern C++ 3.12.0

Unmodified `single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp` from the official v3.12.0 tag:
https://github.com/nlohmann/json/blob/v3.12.0/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp

SHA-256: `aaf127c04cb31c406e5b04a63f1ae89369fccde6d8fa7cdda1ed4f32dfc5de63`

The checksum matches the official release:
https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.12.0

`LICENSE.MIT` is copied unchanged from the same tag. The dependency is used only
by the VAS compiler's project-reader translation unit, not AngelScript or its
add-ons. Builds are offline and do not download or discover this dependency.
The compiler-side implementation retains C++11 compatibility for the standalone
GNU make build; the repository's root CMake toolchain remains C++23.
